sensor_logger.notes: Sensor Logger (iOS and Android) with Accelerometer, Gravity and Gyroscope on and 'Standardise Units & Frames' on. accelerometer = user acceleration without gravity (m/s2), gravity = separate vector (m/s2), gyroscope = rad/s.
